goal: Extend finite evidence design to stochastic future observations by representing each action as a set of possible outcomes under each joint ecological-observation hypothesis.

action_library.semantics: One additional focal survey; outcome is detection count 0 or 1 when each has positive probability.
Four additional focal surveys; outcome is total detections 0..4 with positive probability.
Idealized direct readout of p; deterministic outcome 1.0 or 0.75.
Idealized direct readout of biological target state; deterministic absent or present.

robust_separation_definition: An action robustly separates two active joint hypotheses iff their possible outcome sets are disjoint.
minimum_design_definition: Exact smallest action subset such that every active unresolved hypothesis pair is robustly separated by at least one selected action.

hypotheses.claim: Robust pair separation is equivalent to disjoint possible outcome sets for at least one selected action.
hypotheses.rule: Any mismatch between pair-cover result and augmented set-valued injectivity refutes R1.

hypotheses.claim: Under the frozen active joint set, repeat_one_survey and repeat_four_surveys robustly split zero unresolved pairs because absent/q=0 outcomes overlap the imperfect-detection present outcomes at zero detections.
hypotheses.rule: Any robust pair split by either repeat-survey action refutes R2.

hypotheses.claim: direct_detection_calibration robustly splits exactly two of three active pairs, and direct_target_state_assay robustly splits exactly two of three.
The exact minimum robust separating set is {direct_detection_calibration, direct_target_state_assay}, of size 2.
hypotheses.rule: Any size-1 robust separating design, any different size-2 minimum, or failure of the declared pair to separate all active hypotheses refutes R4.

hypotheses.claim: For the frozen known truth absent::p1, observing the direct p=1 calibration outcome after the prior nondetection history leaves a single compatible joint hypothesis, so the realized adaptive path can terminate after one action even though the worst-case nonadaptive robust design has size 2.
hypotheses.rule: If p=1 calibration leaves more than one active hypothesis for the known truth, or if the worst-case minimum is not 2, R5 is refuted.

claim_boundary: Set-valued support gives guarantee-style separation, not expected information gain.
Actions with overlapping possible outcomes may still be useful probabilistically but are not robust separators.
Direct calibration and direct state assay are idealized upper-bound evidence channels.
All claims are conditional on the frozen reduced joint hypothesis universe.
